Chapter 7052: High Heaven Devourer

Chapter 7052: High Heaven Devourer

“You wouldn’t call yourself that if you were Violet Sun Golden Immortal since it is a cursed name. You were the one to abandon it.” Li Qiye smiled.

“That makes sense.” Others nodded in agreement while the colossal being froze, unable to respond.

“An impersonator?” An overlord murmured.

“Impossible, no one can fake the power of a celestial immortal.” An immortal disagreed.

“Then a soul took over the corpse?” A golden immortal said.

“Whose soul?” Another immortal asked.

No one could answer.

“It doesn’t matter, I am Violet Sun Golden Immortal.” The figure responded.

“Sure thing.” Li Qiye smiled: “I want to see how suitable this living body is for you.”

“Try then.” Zhao Dachui raised both hands and the ten suns behind him rotated.

When he clasped his hands together, the ten suns combined in the blink of an eye. It immediately sucked in all affinities nearby, shaking Heavenrealm itself.

“Boom!” A singularity occurred after the total absorption. The resulting power turned into violet flames capable of engulfing Heavenrealm.

However, Zhao Dachui changed it into a majestic sword capable of cutting any point in time.

“Soaring True Immortal Slayer!” A spectator roared.

The sword pierced through Dusk Realm and Ruin, reaching Heavenrealm itself. Any inhabitant could look up and see a violet sword towering in the air.

“This is Zhao Dachui’s sword technique. But he’s dead, who else learned this technique successfully? No way.” An immortal in Heavenrealm said.

This technique was of the celestial level. However, another celestial immortal wouldn’t bother to use someone else’s grand dao.

“It’s Zhao Dachui.” A spectator inside Dusk Realm said.

This couldn’t be a case of someone possessing Zhao Dachui’s body. The technique appeared flawless.

“Slash!” Zhao Dachui swung the immeasurable blade.

“Damn!” Immortals ran away while an unfortunate overlord was too close and exploded from the shockwaves.

“Bam!” The blade struck Li Qiye.

Everyone was sure this could draw blood. However, Li Qiye still blocked it with his body.

“This is your power? Looks like you can’t muster Zhao Dachui’s true power?” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Again!” Zhao Dachui’s body changed into a black hole.

Dusk Realm fell into darkness since all light was absorbed by this black hole.

The only light came from within - the brightness of the enforcer’s tribulation. Originally, it was dense enough to take on liquid form.

Now, it existed as a solid state of inconceivable density within the black hole. Countless bolts and flames condensed together, forming the outer black hole.

“High Heaven Devourer!” An immortal shouted: “This has to be Zhao Dachui, it’s his signature technique!”

“Must be...” A friend nearby murmured.
